items.title: Role of AI, Apps, and Digital Services in Business

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Role of AI, Apps, and Digital Services in Business under 9.4 as printed (PDF 134, printed 130).

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile apps, and digital services play an important role in modern business growth. AI helps entrepreneurs analyze data, understand customer behavior, and improve decision-making. Mobile apps make it easier for businesses to reach customers, sell products, and provide services quickly. Digital services such as online payments, cloud storage and marketing tools improve efficiency and reduce costs. Together, these technologies support innovation and make businesses more competitive in the digital economy.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: AI tools can now design, write, and even help run businesses.
